The Cognoscenti · production-grade bar

Clear intent, reversible actions, explicit consent, correct state transitions, and a safe fallback when a signal is missing. A completed handover phase is not proof that a runtime behaviour has browser evidence.

Friction, not restriction. The user keeps the decision. Python is shadow-only; Vision is a DOM-failure fallback.
